34:49.text: (the truth i.e. the Qur’ân and Allâh’s Revelation)
can neither create anything nor resurrect

34:50.text: I go astray, I shall stray only to my own loss. But if I remain guided, it is because of the Revelation of my Lord to me. Truly, He is All-Hearer, Ever Near

34:51.text: And if you could but see, when they will be terrified with no escape
, and they will be seized from a near place.

34:52.text: (Faith and the acceptance of their repentance by Allâh)
from a place so far off
(i.e. to return to the worldly life again)

34:53.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh, Islâm, the Qur’ân and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
[i.e. the Hereafter, Hell, Paradise, Resurrection and the Promise of Allâh (by saying) all that is untrue]

34:54.text: And a barrier will be set between them and that which they desire
[i.e. At-Taubah (turning to Allâh in repentance) and the accepting of Faith]
, as was done in the past with the people of their kind. Verily, they have been in grave doubt.

35:1.text: All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the
of the heavens and the earth, Who made the angels messengers with wings, two or three or four. He increases in creation what He wills. Verily, Allâh is Able to do all things.

35:2.text: , Allâh may grant to mankind, none can withhold it; and whatever He may withhold, none can grant it thereafter. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

35:3.text: O mankind! Remember the Grace of Allâh upon you! Is there any creator other than Allâh who provides for you from the sky
and the earth? Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
. How then are you turning away
